articles.summary: Reno, Nev., June 8, 2026 — American Battery Technology Company (NASDAQ: ABAT), an integrated critical mineral manufacturing company that is commercializing its internally-developed technologies for both primary critical minerals manufacturing and secondary critical mineral recycling, announced it has won its appeal with the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) for the reinstatement of its competitive grant award to support…
articles.title: American Battery Technology Company Wins Appeal and Has US Department of Energy Grant Reinstated for $115 million Project for Commercial Scale Critical Mineral Lithium Refinery
